laws.name: Florida Domestic Violence Leave
laws.description: Provides leave for employees of employers with 50 or more employees to seek medical care, legal assistance, counseling, or relocate for safety due to domestic or sexual violence.

laws.name: Florida State Employee Sick Leave
laws.description: Provides paid sick leave for eligible Florida state employees for personal illness or injury.

laws.name: Florida State Employee Family Sick Leave
laws.description: Allows Florida state employees to use accrued sick leave to care for an immediate family member with an illness or injury.
